mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate hiring and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), the supply chain is robust and corporate output is strong, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO (as of t-1mo) exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month indicates weak consumer demand for housing, which reduces overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 from the prior month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
